vuln_statements.explanation: In the original buggy code, this statement was incorrectly placed BEFORE accessing ifp->flags (which occurs at lines 3115-3116 in the fixed version). When ipv6_del_addr() was called first, it freed the inet6_ifaddr structure pointed to by ifp. Subsequent code then attempted to dereference ifp->flags to check temporary address flags, resulting in a use-after-free vulnerability. The fix reordered the code to check ifp->flags before calling ipv6_del_addr().
